entries.name: MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The application (client) id of the store's KaratOS Teams app registration. It holds no Microsoft Graph permissions in Entra; the team grants it ChannelMessage.Read.Group and ChannelSettings.Read.Group when it installs the app.
howToGet: In the Entra admin center, open App registrations, choose New registration, name it KaratOS Teams, keep single tenant and register it. Remove User.Read from its API permissions and add nothing.

Make a Teams app package whose manifest names this client id under webApplicationInfo and asks, under authorization.permissions.resourceSpecific, for ChannelMessage.Read.Group and ChannelSettings.Read.Group as Application permissions, and nothing else.
Upload it as a custom app in the Teams admin center, allow it, and have an owner of the one team install it there, consenting to those two permissions for that team.
Copy the Application (client) ID from the app's Overview.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: A client secret of the KaratOS Teams app, sent only to Microsoft's sign-in for a one-hour Graph token. The connector stops if that token carries any permission that isn't a read one.
howToGet: In the KaratOS Teams app's Certificates & secrets, choose New client secret, describe it as KaratOS and pick the shortest expiry the store is happy to renew.
Copy its Value (not its Secret ID) straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_TEAMS_TEAM_ID
entries.description: The group id of the one team to read, the team the KaratOS Teams app is installed in.
howToGet: In Teams, open the team's menu, choose Get link to team, and copy the groupId value from the link. It must be the team the app is installed in, or Graph answers 403.
